app.generalMapNotice: WayMed is a general-purpose navigation prototype. All demo maps, doctors, and schedules are fictional.

home.title: A clearer way to find your next step.
home.description: A welcoming, multilingual guide helps visitors find a suitable department and navigate a fictional demo facility.
home.actionDescription: A few simple questions help us suggest where to go next. You can always ask a person for help.

story.title: A small idea, grounded in real experiences.
story.description: We listened to families and staff, then focused this prototype on a specific moment when unclear directions cost precious time.
story.actionDescription: Explore how field research led us to focus on helping first-time visitors reach the right department the first time.
story.evidence: Sticky 7 (P2): asked many people for the department; one said emergency no. 3, others sent him elsewhere.

storyMode.questionLabel: Why we are here and the question it answers
storyMode.whyEmpathize: Understand the real experiences of patients' families and hospital support staff before shaping a response.
storyMode.whyDefine: Turn repeated field observations into a focused, actionable design question.
storyMode.whyIdeate: Explore possible responses and make the selection rationale transparent; scores have not been supplied.

storyMode.personaHelp: Select a persona to filter their notes. Colors: yellow = attendants, pink = doctor, green = support staff.
storyMode.researchNote: There was no compounder in our research, so there is no C code.

storyMode.affinityHelp: Filter by group or persona. Sticky wording is kept as supplied; items awaiting teacher review are hidden by default.
storyMode.scopeNote: WayMed prototypes Group B navigation and parts of Groups A and C. It does not fully solve Groups A, C, D, or E. The demo facility and map are fictional.
storyMode.futureScope: Future scope · not solved by this prototype
storyMode.futureScopeHelp: These opportunities come from the field research and are explicitly outside the current prototype.
